title: Open incidents by project
question: Which projects currently have the most open incidents?

sql_tasks.description: Count the number of open incidents per project, and return the projects with the highest counts.

tasks.description: Count the number of open incidents per project, and return the projects with the highest counts.
tasks.sql:
SELECT 
    p.project_id,
    p.name,
    COUNT(i.incident_id) AS open_incidents_count
FROM projects p
JOIN incidents i ON p.project_id = i.project_id
WHERE i.status = 'open'
GROUP BY p.project_id, p.name
ORDER BY open_incidents_count DESC
